items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I played one of my first carnival jobs with him.

ctx.x: He played in the brass band though. And the snare drummer. How old is he?
George. George Sterling. Yeah Sterling. He should be around about close to 60 years old. Around in the 60s or. I know he's over in the 50s. Yeah.
